summary.prose: The build adds two new page-to-host messages and the host code that validates and opens them, extracts one shared path-containment helper, and adds one shared link step that both the chat page and the review pane inline after guardMd. A final reported live check in a running VS Code confirms what no automated test can: a single browser open, the line reached, and the editor group chosen.

tasks.title: Add the open-link and open-code-ref messages to the protocol and the shim
tasks.summary: Add the two webview-to-host message variants and their allowlist entries in protocol.ts, and add env.openExternal, Range and Position to the vscode.d.ts shim.
acceptanceChecks: protocol.ts accepts open-link {url} and open-code-ref {path, line?} and rejects other shapes
the shim compiles a call to env.openExternal and a Range selection

tests.name: protocol allowlist includes open-link and open-code-ref

tasks.title: Extract resolveWithin from companion-reader
tasks.summary: Move the realpath, containment and regular-file check out of companion-reader.ts into an exported resolveWithin(root, relPath, fs) helper, and rewire createCompanionReader onto it with its docs/ root, .html rule and size cap unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: the existing companion reader tests pass unchanged
resolveWithin refuses .. escapes, absolute paths, missing files and a symlink that points outside the root

tests.name: companion-reader behaves as before after the containment helper is extracted
resolveWithin refuses .. escapes, absolute paths, missing files and a symlink that points outside the root

tasks.title: Host handlers for open-link and open-code-ref, injected from extension.ts
tasks.summary: Add the validating handlers to the chat host and the review-pane host, and inject the open-external and open-file-at-line dependencies and the workspace folder from extension.ts. The open-file-at-line dependency takes its viewColumn from the reviewColumn closure and falls back to Beside.
acceptanceChecks: a valid http(s) url is opened externally and any other scheme is refused
an existing in-workspace file opens with the line selected in the column chooseReviewColumn picks, and Beside when it picks none
an absolute path, a .. path, a missing file, a symlink escape and a missing workspace folder are refused and logged
an open that rejects or resolves false is logged and does not throw

tests.name: the host opens a valid http url externally and refuses a non-http url
the host opens an existing in-workspace path with the line selected
the host refuses an absolute path, a .. path, a missing file and a path with no workspace folder
the host refuses a symlink inside the workspace that points outside it
the host logs and survives an open that rejects or resolves false
the host opens a clicked code reference in the column chooseReviewColumn picks, and Beside when it picks none

tasks.title: Linkify and click handling in the chat page
tasks.summary: Define the linkify and click source as one exported string in its own module. In render-registry.ts, inline it after guardMd: wrap code references (including inline code that is wholly a path) in anchors carrying data-path and data-line, strip the href from http(s) anchors and keep data-url, style the handled anchors as links, and add one delegated click handler that prevents the default and posts the message. Keep the innerHTML-then-guardMd pairing. Extend the chat-shell stub DOM with text nodes that support splitting and replacing, and confirm it before writing the linkify tests.
acceptanceChecks: a code reference with a line becomes a link carrying its path and line, in running text and in whole-path inline code
pre blocks, partial inline code, existing anchors and version numbers are not wrapped
an http link has no href and carries data-url, and a click posts open-link with the default prevented
a non-http href is still dropped
render-registry.test.ts guardMd assertions pass

tests.name: a code reference with a line in running text becomes a link carrying its path and line
text inside code and pre and existing anchors is not wrapped
a version number is not treated as a path
a click on an http link posts open-link and prevents the default
a click on a code reference posts open-code-ref with path and line
guardMd still drops a non-http href
an http link keeps its target in data-url and has no href, so it cannot open by itself
inline code whose whole text is a code reference becomes a link

tasks.title: Linkify and click handling in the review pane
tasks.summary: Inline the same exported linkify string once into the review shell inside DOCS_BODY_RENDERER_SOURCE, add the click handler posting through the pane's message channel, rewrite docs-review-panel.test.ts t4 for the new scrub, extend its stub DOM, and update the SHELL_BASELINE pins as the last step, once the shell source has stopped changing.
acceptanceChecks: the renderer source run against a stub DOM links a code reference, strips the href of an http link and posts open-code-ref and open-link on click
t4 asserts no href, a data-url and the unchanged non-http and image scrub
the shell-baseline tests hold with the new pins and the inlines-once test still passes
open-companion handling is unchanged

tests.name: the review pane renderer source, run against a stub DOM, links a code reference, strips the href of an http link, and posts open-code-ref and open-link on click
the chat page and the review pane both include the linkify and click wiring

tasks.title: Live checks in a running VS Code
tasks.summary: Click an http link, a code reference with a line and a code reference while the chat group is the only group, in both the chat and the review pane, and record the results as reported evidence at validate. The gate cannot run these, so the result is the builder's own record and maps to no test file.
acceptanceChecks: an http link opens in the browser exactly once
a code reference opens at its line
the file opens in the chosen editor group, and Beside when only the chat group exists

tests.name: an http link opens in the browser exactly once, in the chat and in the review pane
a code reference opens at its line, in the chosen editor group, and Beside when only the chat group exists
